trap: 记者挑衅：外界普遍认为你们依靠垄断压制创新？
strategy: 重新定义问题 (Redefining Premise) + 站在用户利益反击
questionEn: Critics say your dominance is suffocating smaller innovators. How do you respond?
responseEn: We don't focus on crushing competitors; our obsession has always been empowering small businesses. If empowering 10 million SMEs to survive is considered a monopoly, then we are proud to serve them.
responseZh: 我们从不关注击垮对手，我们的焦点永远是赋能小微企业。如果帮助 1000 万小商家生存被视作某种垄断，那我们很自豪能为他们服务。
punchline: “Don't defend the charge; reframe the mission.” (永远不要为指控辩解，重新定义你的使命。)
